title: Core Scripting, POSIX Systems & Concurrency Traps
summary: Starting with Linux shell scripts, network probes, and Python automation. Encountering the first invisible concurrency and buffer starvation deadlocks.

topicalMastery.description: Understanding OS stream buffers, standard file descriptors, and non-blocking asynchronous consumption.
Deterministic bash scripting, process exit codes, and robust error escalation.

turningPoint: Diagnosing that long-running child processes weren't deadlocked in code logic—they were starved by OS pipe buffer exhaustion (64KB limits).

title: Resilient QA Automation & Web State Machines
summary: Transitioning from fragile DOM-based scraping and test scripts to deterministic, accessibility-anchored automation suites.

topicalMastery.description: Designing deterministic test harnesses that eliminate artificial sleep timeouts and rely on accessible DOM states.
Building zero-latency, local-first in-browser developer tooling utilizing Web Workers and modern web standards.

turningPoint: Replacing fragile XPath/CSS selectors with accessibility role queries (getByRole, aria-busy), reducing false CI test failures from 14% to under 1%.

title: Low-Latency Telemetry & Fault-Tolerant Orchestration
summary: Engineering real-time network diagnostic tools and fault-tolerant background task runners capable of surviving node crashes and high-frequency WebSocket bursts.

topicalMastery.description: Implementing heartbeat monitors, dead-letter replays, exponential backoff, and circuit-breaker patterns on Redis Streams.
Eliminating browser layout thrashing at 2,500 WebSocket events/sec using typed array ring buffers and requestAnimationFrame batching.

turningPoint: Decoupling the high-speed network arrival clock from the browser display refresh clock, dropping per-frame rendering time from 48ms to 2.1ms.

title: Autonomous Agent Systems & Resilient Orchestrators
summary: Building autonomous multi-agent task systems, self-healing background automation, and developer ergonomics infrastructure.

topicalMastery.description: Orchestrating multi-agent collaboration, structured state handoffs, and resilient recovery protocols.
Local-first architectures with offline predictability, minimal dependency footprint, and high-signal observability.

turningPoint: Treating agent systems not as simple chatbots, but as distributed state machines requiring strict backpressure, timeout gates, and observability.
